description: Both radar firmwares listed for the radar-ACC RAV4 in openpilot's fingerprints, 8821F0R01100 and 8821F0R03100, are the Continental ARS510 and send the same bus-1 messages. 8821F0R01100: one minute each from the two opendbc test routes of the TOYOTA_RAV4_TSS2_2022 platform (the RAV4 Hybrid 2022 and RAV4 2022 cars of the original 2022 ports, openpilot #23969 / #24367; logs from comma's public CI store), read with the repo's log reader and run through the acc interface (opendbc branch ars510-acc) and the fused decoder (upstream/ars510_radar.py). 8821F0R03100: the owner's car (drives in this repo).
consequence: The integration selects the parser by the car model (TOYOTA_RAV4_TSS2_2022, TOYOTA_RAV4_TSS2_2023): installer hook ARS510_PLATFORMS, upstream/opendbc_ars510.patch and upstream/toyota_routing.patch. The cycle clock runs at 15.4-16.5 changes per s on both firmwares, inside radard's 8-24 Hz liveTracks window.
